analysis_timing: Post-response literature audit, 2026-09-18; not the pre-inference selection
coordinate_system: 1-based inclusive positions in the submitted 318-base reporter insert
scope: FP1 uses the experimentally footprinted sequence. The other intervals are the exact sequence cores discussed by Astra, localized within the literature's promoter repeats; they are not complete experimentally defined footprints. All 50 candidates remain in the analysis, including positions outside these intervals.

elements.label: FP1
elements.evidence: Mehta et al. 1996: in vivo footprinting, reporter mutagenesis and EMSA; induction experiments involved sterol depletion, unlike this untreated MPRA. The footprint does not identify a specific TF.

elements.label: Repeat 1 core (SREBP1 figure label)
elements.evidence: SatMutMPRA Supplementary Table 12 calls the upstream region SREBP1 and defines the labels as SRE repeats. Peeters et al. 1998 identifies repeat 1 as a distal Sp1 site. These labels do not establish SREBP-1 isoform-specific occupancy.

elements.label: SRE core (SREBP2 figure label)
elements.evidence: Canonical SRE-1 within repeat 2; SREBP/Sp1 cooperation is experimentally supported, but this assay does not separately determine SREBP-1 versus SREBP-2 binding.

elements.label: SP1 / repeat 3 core
elements.evidence: The c.-142C>T allele is V34 at reporter base 177. Mozas et al. 2002 tested this allele directly; SatMutMPRA Supplementary Table 12 independently maps its coordinates and reports the two MPRA replicates.
